# Rhozeland

> A discovery and support network for independent artists. Find creators you care about, support them in any way that fits, and earn on-chain rewards for showing up early.

Rhozeland is a creator-first platform where artists, builders, and influencers get discovered, build a following, and unlock support from fans through events, spaces, services, and on-chain rewards powered by $RHOZE.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page introducing Rhozeland and how it works.
- [Discover](/discover): Browse featured creators, events, and spaces by archetype (Artist, Builder, Influencer).
- [Profiles](/profiles): Directory of creators on Rhozeland.
- [Flow](/flow): Swipeable feed of creator works.
- [Events](/events): Browse upcoming events hosted by creators.
- [Spaces](/spaces): Bookable studios and venues from verified hosts.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Services and offerings from creators.
- [Creator Pass](/credits): Earn $RHOZE, view tier, top up, and learn how rewards work.
- [Conversations](/messages): Direct messages, project threads, and listing inquiries.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign up or log in to Rhozeland.

## Optional

- [Onboarding](/onboarding): New-creator setup flow (logo, region, archetype, bio).
- [Settings](/settings): Profile, wallet, verification, notifications, and account settings.
- [Verification](/settings/verification): Apply to become a Verified Artist.
- [Swap History](/swap-history): History of $RHOZE ↔ creator coin swaps.
